scope: Stora H1-9 physical tee surfaces and nominal navigation references
method: Manual plain/overlay inspection of authenticated native 0.16 m RGBI imagery. Existing physical pads are retained where supported; explicit reference-to-platform associations follow observed spatial and route order, not an automatic nearest-pad rule. Reference positions do not establish surveyed daily markers or tee colours.

The imagery and manual boundary interpretation do not establish absolute survey accuracy or current daily tee-marker positions.
